notes.title: Update 2 is here !
notes.notes:
🚀 Poly Frenzy – Update 2 is here!
Sharpen your aim and load your guns – Update 2 just landed and it’s a BIG one!
We’ve squashed some nasty bugs 🐞, boosted the arsenal 🔫, and made enemies a lot smarter (sorry in advance 😅).
[hr][/hr]✅ Fixes
Fixed aim zoom carrying over between levels

Fixed aim target stuck on player (mouse config only) 🟥 Critical

Fixed precision loss when shooting while aiming

Fixed grenade bug (smoke turning into HE 💣)

Fixed DPS calculation (full shot/reload cycle)

Fixed enemies sometimes invincible on mounds

Fixed UI lock at the end of run 🟥 Critical

Fixed enemies camping in one spot like it’s a BBQ 🍖
[hr][/hr]✨ New Features
New Player Model → Nina is fully animated (move, dash, reload, weapon handling)

Grenade Control Overhaul → Adjust throw distance (triggers or mouse wheel), cancel throws, and quick release for HE & Smoke

Upgrade Panel Rework → No more “Accept” button – hold to choose, with slick animations

New Weapon System → 3 classes: Heavy, Assault, Hand (switch with Y / mouse wheel)

Added Sniper (Vektor-88)

Added Shotgun (Patator)

Added Rifle (KG-Min)

Added Pistol (Brainwasher)

Explosive Barrels → Now trigger chain explosions 💥

Death Sequence → Go out in style 😎
[hr][/hr]⚖️ Gameplay Balancing
Enemies can now be defensive (cover) or aggressive (rush)

Damage now scales by rarity:

Common +5% • Rare +10% • Epic +15% • Instable +20%

Nerfed Mulo-6 pistol (-20% dmg per shot)

Money bonus → Clear a level without taking damage = DOUBLE gains 💰

Endless Run tweaks (new enemy scaling & elite cycles)
[hr][/hr]
👉 Update 2 is live now – jump back into the frenzy, test the new weapons, and let us know how long you can last in the new Endless Run!

notes.title: Update 1 is here !
notes.notes:
Update 1 is here !
Fewer bugs. More features. Same chaotic spirit.
• Safe zone at level start
• Elite enemies every 5 stages
• Smooth new dash
• Smarter shop & vision cones

➡️ Launch the demo on Steam now and feel the Poly Frenzy boost.

 Fixes

\[Gameplay] Fixed character sometimes cannot shoot in new level

\[Gameplay]  Fixed character sometimes stuck in the scenery

\[Gameplay]  Fixed character can be killed by an explosion AFTER a successful level

\[UI] Fixed enemy at 0 hp but still alive ⁠Ennemie à 0 non mort,

\[UI]  Fixed run start button to be the same of the upgrades validation,

--- 

 New Features

\[Smoke grenade] Improved smoke effect on the enemies : they complete loose focus if they enter the zone ⁠Perte de focus des IAsur le jou…,

\[Dash] Improved dash capability : player can now dash everytime, even when in focus. If the player dashes while he focuses, the focus end,

\[UI] Added hold time for loot weapon accept / skip menu, avoiding frustration of bad choice caused by dash,

\[Map] Added the safe zone. Start your level in a safe zone including the shop. In trouble during gun fight ? Go back to there, buy some stuff and take a breath !,

\[Enemies] Added elite versions of the Pistozero and the RifleDude. One of them appear every 5 levels.,

\[Player] Added vignette effect & heart beat sound when low in hp,

--- 

 Gameplay Balancing

\[Pistol] Improved reload sequence : one bullet at a time, the player can now shoot even the whole barrel is not full ⁠Pouvoir tirer même si la rechar…,

\[Enemies] Optimized the vision cone mechanics. Now the cone stays the same even if the player enters the cone. The enemy no longer shoots if the player is outside the cone. That caused of lot of frustration. ⁠Touché par des ennemies en deho…,

\[Shop] Added two more tables,

\[Map] Increased map size by 50%,

\[Ammo] Optimized ammo management in case of new weapon : if the same type (rifle, pistol), the most amount of ammo between them is kept,

\[Weapons] Nerfed rng stats for each qualities above crap
